title: Hearty Umami Korean Chickpeas Jeon
description: A traditional Korean jeon dish featuring chickpeas in a savory and umami-filled batter, perfect for a cozy meal. This recipe is inspired by the cuisine of the Chungcheong region.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, cornstarch, and a pinch of salt.
Add the egg, sesame oil, soy sauce, garlic, and green onions to the bowl and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Add the chickpeas to the batter and stir gently until they are evenly coated.
Heat a non-stick pan with about 1/2 inch of oil over medium heat.
Using a spoon, drop small amounts of the chickpea batter into the pan and flatten them slightly.
Cook the jeon for about 3-4 minutes on each side, until they are golden brown and crispy.
Remove the jeon from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the jeon hot and enjoy.
Garnish with additional green onions and a sprinkle of toasted sesame seeds if desired.
